# Vendored code

`foliate-js/` is [foliate-js](https://github.com/johnfactotum/foliate-js) by John Factotum (MIT, see `foliate-js/LICENSE`),
copied from the 1.0.1 npm tarball. foliate-js is not published as a supported npm package, and its docs recommend
copying it in. Only `view.d.ts` was added (typings used by OwlReader); no upstream file was modified.
